name: CFPro Direct Order
author: EsLaM Hamed

sections.description:
CFPro Direct Order is an enterprise-grade social commerce and WhatsApp sales automation plugin for WooCommerce. Designed specifically for high-trust markets and direct customer selling, it enables merchants to convert product page visitors into WhatsApp conversations and completed orders effortlessly.

Watch Full Plugin Walkthrough & Setup Video on YouTube

🌟 Key Features & Smart Arsenal

  • Direct WhatsApp Order Button: Replace or complement standard WooCommerce Add to Cart buttons with high-converting WhatsApp CTAs.
  • WhatsApp Message Templates Studio: Fully customizable 6 automated message templates (New Order Admin, Confirmation Request Customer, Bot Confirmed Response Customer, Confirmed Admin Notice, Bot Cancelled Response Customer, Cancelled Admin Notice).
  • Lead Capture Popup Modal: Capture customer name, phone number, delivery address, and order notes directly on the product page before sending them to WhatsApp or processing the order.
  • Granular Form Field Controls: Customize popup fields with individual visibility and required field toggles.
  • SaaS Gateway & Evolution API Integration: Pair your store with CFPro Cloud (QR Code connection) for fully automated, background WhatsApp messaging without manual customer redirects.
  • Automated Interactive Bot & Confirmations: Instantly send order confirmation requests to customers on WhatsApp upon order creation with automated reply handling (Reply 1 to confirm, 2 to cancel).
  • Floating WhatsApp Button: Customizable floating action button with live pulse animation and flexible screen positioning (Bottom Right / Left).
  • Button Visibility Rules: Option to hide default WooCommerce “Add to Cart” or third-party “Buy Now” buttons.
  • Real-Time Analytics Dashboard: Track real WhatsApp clicks, response rates, and conversion lift inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • Full RTL & Multilingual Support: Native Arabic and English interface for both admin and storefront.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide automated WhatsApp messaging, QR code device connection verification, and order confirmation bot webhooks.

  • Service Name: ChatFlow Pro SaaS Gateway / Evolution API
  • Service Purpose: Manages background WhatsApp API connections, QR code authentication, automated order confirmation requests, and bot webhook responses.
  • Data Sent: Customer phone number, customer name, order ID, product items breakdown, total price, delivery address, and API connection tokens. Data is transmitted securely via HTTPS.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent when a customer places an order via the WhatsApp direct modal, when the automated bot processes a customer response, or when an administrator tests/verifies the SaaS gateway connection.
  • Terms of Service: https://chatflow-pro.site/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://chatflow-pro.site/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cfpro-direct-order directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > WA Direct Order to configure your WhatsApp business phone number and features.
  4. (Optional) Connect your store to CFPro Cloud via QR Code under the SaaS Gateway settings for automated background messaging.
sections.faq:
Does CFPro Direct Order require a paid API subscription?

No! You can use the standard WhatsApp direct link mode for free without any API setup. However, connecting to the CFPro SaaS Gateway unlocks automated background messaging, QR code pairing, and instant customer notifications.

Does this plugin work with variable WooCommerce products?

Yes! CFPro Direct Order passes product names, pricing, permalinks, and full cart breakdowns into WhatsApp templates.

Is CFPro Direct Order compatible with RTL and Arabic language sites?

Absolutely. The plugin is built with full native RTL layout support and custom Arabic message templates.
